product_id.INVALID: Product ID is invalid or does not match the required format.
product_id.EMPTY: Product ID is required for all products and variants.

product_title.INVALID: Product title contains unsupported characters or exceeds the maximum length of 255 characters.

product_type.INVALID: Product type is not recognized or is not supported. "Physical" or "Digital" are supported entries.

product_media_urls.INVALID: Media URLs must be valid links formatted as a CSV list.
product_media_urls.EMPTY: At least one media URL is required.

product_description_html.INVALID: Description contains invalid text or unsupported HTML.

hide_variant.INVALID: Hide Variant must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

option1_name.INVALID: Option 1 name contains unsupported characters or is not unique.
option1_name.EMPTY: Option 1 name is required when variations are enabled.

option1_value.EMPTY: Option 1 value cannot be empty when option 1 name is provided.

option2_name.INVALID: Option 2 name contains unsupported characters or is not unique.
option2_name.EMPTY: Option 2 name is required when Option 2 values are provided.

option2_value.EMPTY: Option 2 value cannot be empty when option 2 name is provided.

option3_name.INVALID: Option 3 name contains unsupported characters or is not unique.
option3_name.EMPTY: Option 3 name is required when Option 3 values are provided.

option3_value.EMPTY: Option 3 value cannot be empty when option 3 name is provided.

variant_image.INVALID: Variant image must be a valid URL.
variant_image.EMPTY: Variant image is required when specifying a variant-specific image.

price.INVALID: Price must be a valid number greater than 0.

quantity.INVALID: Quantity must be a whole number that meets stock requirements.
quantity.EMPTY: Quantity is required when overselling is disabled.

sku.INVALID: SKU must be unique and contain only valid characters.

weight.INVALID: Weight must be a valid number greater than 0.

unit.INVALID: Unit must be one of: KG, G, LB, OZ.

country_of_origin.INVALID: Country of origin must be a valid two-letter ISO country code.

sections.INVALID: Sections must be valid comma-separated values.
sections.EMPTY: At least one section is required.

tags.INVALID: Tags must be valid comma-separated values.
tags.EMPTY: At least one tag is required.

product_status.INVALID: Product status must be ACTIVE, DRAFT, or ARCHIVED.
